project.title: Long-term effects of ZnO nanoparticles on nitrogen and phosphorus removal, microbial activity and microbial community of a sequencing batch reactor
project.description: This study investigated the long-term effects of ZnO NPs on the nitrogen and phosphorus removal rate, microbial enzymatic activity, and as well as microbial community structure and compositionof activated sludge in a SBR.

samples: the V4 region of the 16S rDNA in activated sludge
explicit urban setting at sample level
